papers.title: YOLO26: Key Architectural Enhancements and Performance Benchmarking for Real-Time Object Detection
papers.authors: Ranjan Sapkota, Rahul Harsha Cheppally, Ajay Sharda, Manoj Karkee
papers.affiliations: ¹Cornell University, Biological & Environmental Engineering, Ithaca, NY, USA；²Kansas State University, Department of Biological and Agricultural Engineering, Manhattan, KS, USA
papers.intro: 本文系统地分析和基准测试了Ultralytics YOLO26架构，该模型通过消除NMS和DFL、引入ProgLoss-STAL标签分配及MuSGD优化器，在边缘设备上实现了更高效率、更稳训练和出色的小目标检测性能。

papers.title: MinerU2.5: A Decoupled Vision-Language Model for Efficient High-Resolution Document Parsing
papers.authors: Junbo Niu, Zheng Liu, Zhuangcheng Gu, Bin Wang, Linke Ouyang, Zhiyuan Zhao, Tao Chu, Tianyao He, Fan Wu, Qintong Zhang, Zhenjiang Jin, Guang Liang, Rui Zhang, Wenzheng Zhang, Yuan Qu, Zhifei Ren, Yuefeng Sun, Yuanhong Zheng, Dongsheng Ma, Zirui Tang, Boyu Niu, Ziyang Miao, Hejun Dong, Siyi Qian, Junyuan Zhang, Jingzhou Chen, Fangdong Wang, Xiaomeng Zhao, Liqun Wei, Wei Li, Shasha Wang, Ruiliang Xu, Yuanyuan Cao, Lu Chen, Qianqian Wu, Huaiyu Gu, Lindong Lu, Keming Wang, Dechen Lin, Guanlin Shen, Xuanhe Zhou, Linfeng Zhang, Yuhang Zang, Xiaoyi Dong, Jiaqi Wang, Bo Zhang, Lei Bai, Pei Chu, Weijia Li, Jiang Wu, Lijun Wu, Zhenxiang Li, Guangyu Wang, Zhongying Tu, Chao Xu, Kai Chen, Yu Qiao, Bowen Zhou, Dahua Lin, Wentao Zhang, Conghui He
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Peking University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (具体作者隶属关系见论文正文第一页脚注)
papers.intro: MinerU2.5提出一种解耦的两阶段“粗到细”文档解析策略，先对下采样图像进行全局布局分析，再根据布局引导从原始图像裁剪局部区域进行原生分辨率细粒度识别，以仅1.2B参数实现了全面超越通用及专用模型的最新性能，同时显著降低计算开销。

papers.title: FitPro: A Zero-Shot Framework for Interactive Text-based Pedestrian Retrieval in Open World
papers.authors: Zengli Luo, Canlong Zhang, Xiaochun Lu, Zhixin Li
papers.affiliations: 广西师范大学（教育部教育区块链与智能技术重点实验室、广西多源信息挖掘与安全重点实验室）；广州中医药大学基础医学院
papers.intro: FitPro是一个面向开放世界的交互式零样本文本行人检索框架，通过特征对比解码、增量语义挖掘和查询感知分层检索三个模块，实现了跨场景泛化与多轮交互中的渐进式语义建模。

papers.title: ScaleCUA: Scaling Open-Source Computer Use Agents with Cross-Platform Data
papers.authors: Zhaoyang Liu, Jingjing Xie, Zichen Ding, Zehao Li, Bowen Yang, Zhenyu Wu, Xuehui Wang, Qiushi Sun, Shi Liu, Weiyun Wang, Shenglong Ye, Qingyun Li, Xuan Dong, Yue Yu, Chenyu Lu, YunXiang Mo, Yao Yan, Zeyue Tian, Xiao Zhang, Yuan Huang, Yiqian Liu, Weijie Su, Gen Luo, Xiangyu Yue, Biqing Qi, Kai Chen, Bowen Zhou, Yu Qiao, Qifeng Chen, Wenhai Wang
papers.tags: visual grounding, OCR, multimodal learning, gui
papers.affiliations: Shanghai AI Laboratory
papers.intro: 本文提出ScaleCUA，通过一个整合自动化代理和人类专家的闭环数据管道，构建了覆盖6个操作系统和3个任务领域的跨平台大规模数据集，并基于该数据训练了一系列统一感知、推理和行动的基础模型，在多个GUI基准上取得新SOTA结果。

papers.title: Chat-Driven Text Generation and Interaction for Person Retrieval
papers.authors: Zequn Xie, Chuxin Wang, Sihang Cai, Yeqiang Wang, Shulei Wang, Tao Jin
papers.tags: multimodal learning, CLIP, image retrieval, video search
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University（浙江大学）；Northwest A&F University（西北农林科技大学）
papers.intro: 论文提出CTGI（Chat-Driven Text Generation and Interaction），利用多模态大语言模型的多轮对话能力，在训练阶段自动生成丰富伪标注（MTG），在推理阶段交互式细化用户查询（MTI），从而在无需人工描述的情况下提升文本行人检索的准确性、鲁棒性和实用性。

papers.title: MobileRL: Online Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.authors: Yifan Xu, Xiao Liu, Xinghan Liu, Jiaqi Fu, Hanchen Zhang, Bohao Jing, Shudan Zhang, Yuting Wang, Wenyi Zhao, Yuxiao Dong
papers.affiliations: 清华大学（Tsinghua University），Z.AI
papers.intro: 本文提出MobileRL框架，通过两阶段SFT热身和难度自适应GRPO算法（ADAGRPO），显著提升了移动GUI Agent在AndroidWorld和AndroidLab上的任务成功率，达到新最优。

papers.title: Are LLM Agents the New RPA? A Comparative Study with RPA Across Enterprise Workflows
papers.authors: Petr Průcha, Michaela Matoušková, Jan Strnad
papers.affiliations: Technical University of Liberec（Petr Průcha, Michaela Matoušková），Pointee Inc.（Jan Strnad）
papers.intro: 本文通过控制实验对比RPA（UiPath）与AACU（Anthropic Computer Use Agent）在三个标准RPA挑战（数据录入、监测、发票提取）上的速度、可靠性和开发时间，发现RPA在速度和可靠性上占优，但AACU在开发时间和界面适应性上显著更优。

papers.title: FastTracker: Real-Time and Accurate Visual Tracking
papers.authors: Hamidreza Hashempoor, Yu Dong Hwang
papers.tags: tracking, object detection, autonomous driving, video segmentation, BEV perception
papers.affiliations: Pintel Co. Ltd., Seoul, South Korea
papers.intro: FastTracker提出了一种轻量级、实时的多类别多目标跟踪框架，通过遮挡感知的再识别机制和道路结构感知的轨迹细化策略，在不依赖深度ReID网络的情况下实现了复杂交通场景中的鲁棒跟踪，并发布了新的多类别车辆跟踪基准数据集。

papers.title: ComputerRL: Scaling End-to-End Online Reinforcement Learning for Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Hanyu Lai, Xiao Liu, Yanxiao Zhao, Han Xu, Hanchen Zhang, Bohao Jing, Yanyu Ren, Shuntian Yao, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang
papers.affiliations: 1 Tsinghua University, 2 Z.AI, 3 University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 本文提出ComputerRL框架，通过API-GUI交互范式、分布式RL基础设施和Entropulse训练策略，实现了端到端在线RL训练计算机使用代理，在OSWorld基准上取得48.9%的成功率，超越多个闭源模型。

papers.title: CRAFT-GUI: Curriculum-Reinforced Agent For GUI Tasks
papers.authors: Songqin Nong, Xiaoxuan Tang, Jingxuan Xu, Sheng Zhou, Jianfeng Chen, Tao Jiang, Wenhao Xu
papers.affiliations: Ant Group, Zhejiang University
papers.intro: 提出CRAFT-GUI，一种结合课程学习与细粒度奖励的GRPO强化学习框架，通过按轨迹难度分阶段训练并设计混合奖励机制，显著提升GUI代理在操作和理解任务上的性能。

papers.title: UI-Venus Technical Report: Building High-performance UI Agents with RFT
papers.authors: Zhangxuan Gu, Zhengwen Zeng, Zhenyu Xu, Xingran Zhou, Shuheng Shen, Yunfei Liu, Beitong Zhou, Changhua Meng, Tianyu Xia, Weizhi Chen, Yue Wen, Jingya Dou, Fei Tang, Jinzhen Lin, Yulin Liu, Zhenlin Guo, Yichen Gong, Heng Jia, Changlong Gao, Yuan Guo, Yong Deng, Zhenyu Guo, Liang Chen, Weiqiang Wang
papers.affiliations: Ant Group
papers.intro: 本文提出UI-Venus，基于Qwen2.5-VL并使用强化微调（RFT，基于GRPO算法）训练的高性能UI agent，通过精心设计的奖励函数、数据清洗策略和自演化框架，在UI grounding和navigation任务上取得SOTA性能，并开源了7B和72B模型。

papers.title: DINOv3
papers.authors: Oriane Siméoni, Huy V. Vo, Maximilian Seitzer, Federico Baldassarre, Maxime Oquab, Cijo Jose, Vasil Khalidov, Marc Szafraniec, Seungeun Yi, Michaël Ramamonjisoa, Francisco Massa, Daniel Haziza, Luca Wehrstedt, Jianyuan Wang, Timothée Darcet, Théo Moutakanni, Leonel Sentana, Claire Roberts, Andrea Vedaldi, Jamie Tolan, John Brandt, Camille Couprie, Julien Mairal, Hervé Jégou, Patrick Labatut, Piotr Bojanowski

papers.affiliations: Meta AI Research（除标注外）；John Brandt - WRI；Julien Mairal - Inria
papers.intro: DINOv3通过数据缩放、模型架构改进、Gram锚定（Gram anchoring）训练和后处理策略，成功训练了一个7B参数的视觉基础模型，在密集预测任务上显著超越先前自监督和弱监督模型，同时保持全局任务上的竞争力。

papers.title: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for GUI Grounding via Region Consistency
papers.authors: Yong Du, Yuchen Yan, Fei Tang, Zhengxi Lu, Chang Zong, Weiming Lu, Shengpei Jiang, Yongliang Shen
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University, Central South University, Zhejiang University of Science and Technology, SF Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出两种测试时缩放方法——GUI-RC（基于空间投票的测试时聚合）和GUI-RCPO（基于区域一致性的测试时强化学习），无需标注数据即可显著提升GUI grounding精度。

papers.title: OS Agents: A Survey on MLLM-based Agents for General Computing Devices Use
papers.authors: Unknown
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学（Zhejiang University），复旦大学（Fudan University），OPPO AI中心（OPPO AI Center），中国科学院大学（University of Chinese Academy of Sciences），中国科学院自动化研究所（Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences），香港中文大学（The Chinese University of Hong Kong），清华大学（Tsinghua University），上海交通大学（Shanghai Jiao Tong University），01.AI（01.AI），香港理工大学（The Hong Kong Polytechnic University）
papers.intro: 本文是一篇针对基于多模态大语言模型的操作系统代理（OS Agents）的全面综述，系统梳理了其基础组件、核心能力、构建方法（基础模型与代理框架）、评估协议与基准，并讨论了安全隐私、个性化等未来挑战。

papers.title: Evolving in Tasks: Empowering the Multi-modality Large Language Model as the Computer Use Agent
papers.authors: Yuhao Cheng, Liang Tang, Shuxian Li, Yukang Huo, Tiaonan Duan, Kaer Huang, Yanzhe Jing, Yiqiang Yan
papers.affiliations: Lenovo Research（Beijing, China）、 China Agricultural University（Beijing, China）
papers.intro: 本文提出Self-Evolution Agent (SEA)，通过自动可验证数据生成、高效分步强化学习和模型增强，仅用7B参数就达到了与32B/72B模型可比的计算机使用任务性能。

papers.title: MMBench-GUI: Hierarchical Multi-Platform Evaluation Framework for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Xuehui Wang, Zhenyu Wu, JingJing Xie, Zichen Ding, Bowen Yang, Zehao Li, Zhaoyang Liu, Qingyun Li, Xuan Dong, Zhe Chen, Weiyun Wang, Xiangyu Zhao, Jixuan Chen, Haodong Duan, Tianbao Xie, Chenyu Yang, Shiqian Su, Yue Yu, Yuan Huang, Yiqian Liu, Xiao Zhang, Yanting Zhang, Xiangyu Yue, Weijie Su, Xizhou Zhu, Wei Shen, Jifeng Dai, Wenhai Wang
papers.affiliations: 1上海人工智能实验室，2上海交通大学，3厦门大学，4中国科学技术大学，5香港科技大学，6哈尔滨工业大学，7清华大学，8南京大学，9复旦大学，10香港大学，11东华大学，12香港中文大学

papers.title: MS-DETR: Towards Effective Video Moment Retrieval and Highlight Detection by Joint Motion-Semantic Learning
papers.authors: Hongxu Ma, Guanshuo Wang, Fufu Yu, Qiong Jia, Shouhong Ding
papers.affiliations: Fudan University; Tencent Youtu Lab
papers.intro: MS-DETR通过解耦运动与语义特征、设计任务相互协作的编码器-解码器，并引入语料生成和对比去噪学习，有效提升了视频时刻检索和精彩片段检测的联合精度。

papers.title: Minimizing the Pretraining Gap: Domain-aligned Text-Based Person Retrieval
papers.authors: Shuyu Yang, Yaxiong Wang, Yongrui Li, Li Zhu, Zhedong Zheng
papers.tags: diffusion model, image generation, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: Xi'an Jiaotong University, Hefei University of Technology, University of Macau
papers.intro: 本文提出一种包含图像级领域自适应（Domain-aware Diffusion, DaD）和区域级多粒度关系对齐（Multi-granularity Relation Alignment, MRA）的统一管道，通过生成领域对齐的合成数据集SDA并联合全局-局部对齐，显著缩小预训练与真实数据之间的领域…

papers.title: TRACER: Efficient Object Re-Identification in Networked Cameras through Adaptive Query Processing
papers.authors: Pramod Chunduri, Yao Lu, Joy Arulraj
papers.affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology; National University of Singapore
papers.intro: TRACER是一个基于自适应查询处理框架的视频数据库管理系统，通过递归网络学习长期跨摄像头相关性，并结合概率自适应搜索算法，在满足高召回约束的前提下显著加速跨摄像头对象重识别查询。

papers.title: GTA1: GUI Test-time Scaling Agent
papers.authors: Yan Yang, Dongxu Li, Yutong Dai, Yuhao Yang, Ziyang Luo, Zirui Zhao, Zhiyuan Hu, Junzhe Huang, Amrita Saha, Zeyuan Chen, Ran Xu, Liyuan Pan, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Junnan Li
papers.affiliations: Salesforce AI Research（主要机构），The Australian National University，University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文提出GTA1，通过测试时缩放（test-time scaling）策略增强规划阶段的动作选择质量，并利用强化学习（GRPO）直接预测点击坐标，无需显式推理，从而实现Graphical User Interface（GUI）接地与任务执行的当前最优性能。
